description: St. Paul, MN – Representative Cheryl Youakim (DFL-Hopkins) passed a bill in the Minnesota House today updating Minnesota’s Hometown Heroes Assistance Program. “Firefighters face cancer, cardiac issues, and mental health challenges at higher rates than the rest of us just for doing their jobs; jobs that we ask of them and that many of us are not […]
title: Release: Minnesota House passes bipartisan improvements to the state’s Hometown Heroes Assistance Program - Youakim for State Representative
